assertions.subject: Parkinsonism due to stroke
assertions.quote: Parkinsonism due to stroke is a less common form of acute onset

assertions.subject: Parkinson disease
assertions.predicate: insidious degeneration of the substantia nigra
assertions.quote: most forms of Parkinson disease are due to the insidious degeneration of the substantia nigra

assertions.subject: Parkinson disease
assertions.quote: These forms of Parkinson disease are termed idiopathic due to their unknown cause

assertions.subject: Drug-induced parkinsonism
assertions.quote: drug-induced parkinsonism in which a patient is taking a pharmaceutical compound, such as antipsychotics and antihypertensive, that affects dopamine metabolism

assertions.subject: Antipsychotic-Induced Parkinsonism
assertions.quote: drug-induced parkinsonism in which a patient is taking a pharmaceutical compound, such as antipsychotics and antihypertensive, that affects dopamine metabolism

assertions.subject: Vascular parkinsonism
assertions.predicate: onset within one year of a stroke
assertions.quote: When Parkinson disease is the result of a stroke of the central nervous system, it is called vascular parkinsonism and usually develops within one year of a stroke

assertions.subject: Progressive supranuclear palsy
assertions.quote: Progressive supranuclear palsy produces balance, movement, and gait problems

assertions.subject: Dementia with Lewy bodies
assertions.quote: Dementia with Lewy bodies is a form of parkinsonism that manifests as a progressive cognitive decline

assertions.subject: Multiple systems atrophy
assertions.quote: Multiple systems atrophy can manifest as Parkinson disease but may have degenerative elements that affect many other regions of the brain, which may include autonomic failure

assertions.subject: Corticobasal degeneration
assertions.quote: Corticobasal degeneration also manifests as a form of parkinsonism with severe coordination impairment
